title: I-71 North-South between MM 0.1 and 2.0 Between I-64/I-71 Interchange and Zorn Ave. in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : (March 17, 2026) – Overnight single lane closures are scheduled on Interstate 71 North and South in Louisville for six nights beginning Thursday, March 19, as contract crews perform pavement repairs along the I-71 Widening and Improvement Project [links-1.govdelivery.com] corridor. Traffic is currently shifted to the outside shoulders on both northbound and southbound I-71 to provide crews adequate space to safely prepare for future widening work. Beginning Thursday, March 19, contract crews will remove the existing asphalt and install new pavement in the right lanes between the I-65/I-71 interchange near Frankfort Avenue and the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange. Overnight closures of the right lane on I-71 North: From 8 p.m. Thursday, March 19, to 5 a.m. Friday, March 20 From 8 p.m. Friday, March 20, to 5 a.m. Saturday, March 21 From 8 p.m. Sunday, March 22, to 5 a.m. Monday, March 23 Overnight closures of the right lane on I-71 South: From 8 p.m. Monday, March 23, to 5 a.m. Tuesday, March 24 From 8 p.m. Tuesday, March 24, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, March 25 From 8 p.m. Wednesday, March 25, to 5 a.m. Thursday, March 26 (March 25, 2026) – The schedule for overnight single lane closures on Interstate 71 North and South in Louisville for contract crews to perform pavement repairs as part of the I-71 Widening and Improvement Project [links-1.govdelivery.com] has been adjusted due to recent weather conditions and fluctuating temperatures. Traffic is currently shifted to the outside shoulders on both northbound and southbound I-71 between the I-65/I-71 interchange near Frankfort Avenue and the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange to provide crews adequate space to safely prepare for future widening work. Due to recent weather conditions and fluctuating temperatures, four additional nights of overnight single lane closures are expected as crews continue to perform pavement work on I-71. The adjusted schedule is below. Overnight single lane closures on I-71 North: From 8 p.m. Wednesday, March 25, to 5 a.m. Thursday, March 26 From 8 p.m. Sunday, March 29, to 5 a.m. Monday, March 30 Overnight single lane closures on I-71 South: From 8 p.m. Wednesday, March 25, to 5 a.m. Thursday, March 26 From 8 p.m. Thursday, March 26, to 5 a.m. Friday, March 27 From 8 p.m. Friday, March 27, to 5 a.m. Saturday, March 28 From 8 p.m. Sunday, March 29, to 5 a.m. Monday, March 30 These repairs are intended to improve ride quality for motorists. Recent heavy rainfall and fluctuating temperatures caused the asphalt pavement to deteriorate prematurely. All work being performed is part of the $50 million I-71 widening and improvement project. The two-year project will increase capacity for the corridor from four lanes to six lanes, easing traffic congestion, increasing safety, and improving efficiency. The interstate project is expected to be completed by the fall of 2027. The work is being carried out by Haydon Bridge Co. Inc. of Springfield, Kentucky. More details, including project timelines and traffic impacts, will be shared online as work progresses [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Motorists are encouraged to sign up for email alerts regarding traffic impacts pertaining to the project [links-1.govdelivery.com]. title: I-65 South between MM 137.0 and 136.7 On Kennedy Bridge in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : (Feb. 17, 2026) – Work on the John F. Kennedy Memorial Bridge is advancing to the second and final phase of the expansion joint replacement project, which began last year. To assist with the implementation of a traffic shift, rolling roadblocks and lane closures are scheduled to begin Friday, Feb. 20. Contract crews have completed the replacement of the expansion joints in the right three lanes, allowing work to advance to replacing expansion joints in the left three lanes of the bridge. To safely shift traffic and begin the final phase of work, rolling roadblocks and lane closures will take place on Interstate 65 South on the Kennedy Bridge beginning at 7 p.m. on Friday, Feb. 20, continuing through 6 p.m. on Saturday, Feb. 21. During this time, traffic on southbound I-65 will be reduced to the right two lanes to allow contract crews to safely shift all traffic. As part of this transition, the I-65 South to I-64 West ramp, which has been closed to support work on the southernmost expansion joint, will reopen. Following this weekend’s traffic changes, all traffic will be using the right three lanes while work takes place in the left three lanes to replace the remaining expansion joints. This traffic pattern will remain in place through project completion. Overnight closures of the bridge are expected during the final phase of the project. The overnight closures are necessary to prevent any bridge movement while contract crews perform steel repairs underneath the roadway. This work involves precision machining, known as line boring, and the bridge must remain free of traffic to ensure the accuracy and alignment of the repairs. Additional details on upcoming overnight closures will be shared when available. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. title: I-71 North-South between MM 52.7 and 57.3 Between Exit 55 and Exit 62 in Gallatin County
description: Construction / Road Work : A widening project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on I-71 in Carroll and Gallatin counties is in progress. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes. Beginning at 7 p.m. on Sunday, April 12, crews will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, these ramps will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. I-71 southbound off-ramp to Exit 55 (KY 1039) Exit 57 (KY 35/Sparta Pike) on-ramp to I-71 southbound A signed detour will be in place utilizing Boone Road (KY 465). Weather permitting, these ramp closures are expected to wrap up by Sunday, April 26. We will advise if more time is needed to complete the work. Additionally, a single lane closure on I-71 southbound between Exit 55 and Exit 57 will begin at 7 p.m. on Sunday, April 12, to allow crews to adjust the barrier wall. The lane is expected to reopen by 8 a.m. on Monday, April 13.​ *** Traffic on I-71 southbound has shifted onto newly constructed pavement in the median area while crews reconstruct the original southbound lanes. During this phase, crews are removing the existing pavement and completing shoulder work on I-71 southbound. This widening project includes a bridge replacement over KY 47. The current bridges will be replaced with a new, single span bridge matching the median widening throughout the project area. The speed limit in the work zone has been reduced to 55 MPH, and law enforcement will be on-site to ensure compliance. Please, drive carefully throughout the work zone. Weather permitting, the overall project is expected to be completed Nov. 1, 2026. *** A portion of ramp widening work has been completed ahead of schedule. The ramps listed below have reopened: I-71 southbound off-ramp to Exit 55 (KY 1039) Exit 57 (KY 35/Sparta Pike) on-ramp to I-71 southbound​ *** Beginning at 7 p.m. on Sunday, April 26, crews will close Exit 55 (KY 1039) on-ramp to I-71 southbound. During the closure, the contractor will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, the ramp will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. A signed detour will be in place utilizing I-71 northbound to Exit 57 (KY 35/Sparta Pike) to reenter I-71 southbound. Weather permitting, the ramp closure is expected to be in place through Sunday, May 10. Additional updates will be provided if more time is needed to complete the work. Additionally, a single lane closure on I-71 southbound between Exit 55 and Exit 57 will begin at 7 p.m. on Sunday, April 26, to allow crews to adjust the barrier wall. The lane is expected to reopen by 8 a.m. on Monday, April 27.

title: I-64 East Ramp from Hurstbourne Parkway in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : LOUISVILLE, Ky. (June 16, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight ramp closures on I-64 East tonight, June 16, in Jefferson County. The I-64 East on-ramp from KY 1747 (Hurstbourne Parkway) will be closed from 7 p.m. Tuesday, June 16, through 6 a.m. Wednesday, June 17. The I-64 East off-ramp to KY 1747 (Hurstbourne Parkway) at Exit 15C will also be closed during this time. Contract crews will be performing asphalt resurfacing on portions of the interstate ramps during the overnight closures. The work being performed is part of the current asphalt resurfacing project on KY 1747 (Hurstbourne Parkway) from KY 155 (Taylorsville Road) to KY 1447 (Westport Road), and the project will be substantially complete following tonight's overnight ramp closures. Motorists should heed signage, use caution, and plan ahead for delays.

title: I-71/75 North-South between MM 190.0 and 191.1 Approaching Brent Spence Bridge in Kenton County
description: Construction / Road Work : COVINGTON, Ky. (June 22, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight lane closures on Interstate 71/75 in Kenton County beginning on Monday, June 22. Crews will be filling in rumble strips and performing striping operations ahead of an upcoming traffic shift. Crews will be working on I-71/75 northbound and southbound from south of the 12th Street/MLK Jr. Boulevard off-ramps (190 mile point) to the southern approach of the Brent Spence Bridge (191.1 mile point), a distance of 1.1 miles. Beginning at 8 p.m., crews will block a single left lane in the project area. A double left lane closure will begin at 11 p.m. All lanes are expected to reopen by 5 a.m. daily. All exit ramps currently open will remain open during this portion of the project. Motorists are encouraged to find alternate routes utilizing I-275 and I-471 during working hours to avoid delays. No work will be permitted to take place during the Fourth of July holiday weekend (Friday, July 3 through Sunday, July 5). Weather permitting, this work is expected to be completed by Friday, July 17. KYTC will provide an update once the traffic shift is scheduled.

title: I-275 East between MM 80.7 and 81.2 Between Madison Pike and Turkeyfoot Road in Kenton County
description: Freeway Maintenance : COVINGTON, Ky. (June 23, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of a daytime lane closure on Interstate 275 eastbound in Kenton County beginning on Wednesday, June 24. Crews will be performing pothole repairs on the bridge over Horsebranch Road. Crews will block the right lane on I-275 eastbound between the hours of 9 a.m. and 4 p.m. from east of Turkeyfoot Road (KY 1303) (81.3 mile point) to just past the bridge over Horsebranch Road (80.6 mile point), a distance of 0.7 miles. Both the eastbound I-275 on-ramp from Turkeyfoot Road and I-275 eastbound off-ramp at Madison Pike (KY 17) will remain open during working hours. This work is being performed during daytime hours to provide suitable conditions for the concrete to cure on the bridge deck. Motorists are encouraged to find alternate routes during working hours to avoid any potential delays. Weather permitting, this pothole repair project is expected to be completed on Tuesday, June 30. KYTC will advise if additional days are needed for this repair project. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow [links-1.govdelivery.com] or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress [links-1.govdelivery.com] website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly Twitter). For statewide traffic and travel updates, visit GoKY [links-1.govdelivery.com].

title: I-64 East between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 East beginning Monday, July 6, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. beginning Monday, July 6, through Tuesday, July 21, on I-64 East between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to perform asphalt paving operations. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026.

title: I-71 North between MM 53.0 and 57.0 Between KY-47 and Sparta Pike in Carroll County
description: Freeway Maintenance : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight bridge work on Interstate 71 northbound beginning Thursday, July 16, as part of the ongoing I-71 widening project on an approximately 4.59 mile portion of I-71 in Gallatin and Carroll Counties. Tentative Schedule of Work (Weather Permitting): Beginning at 10 p.m. Thursday, July 16, crews will close a single northbound lane of traffic between mile markers 53 and 57. The right lane will be closed until 4 a.m. to allow crews to safely perform beam setting on the bridge over KY 47. The following ramp closures will also be in place: I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 55 (KY 1039) I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) The on-ramps from Exit 55 (KY 1039) and Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) to I-71 northbound will remain open and will not be impacted by this work. The lane and ramp closures will reopen by 4 a.m. Friday, July 17. As part of the bridge beam setting operation, KY 47 will also be closed to through traffic at the I-71 underpass (between mile points 0.1 and 0.3 in Gallatin County) beginning at 8 p.m. The closure will remain in place overnight, with the roadway expected to reopen by 6 a.m. Friday, July 17. Once this work is complete, the new single-span bridge, designed to accommodate the widened median throughout the project area, will be substantially complete, with only the bridge deck pour and barrier wall installation remaining. Message boards will be in place to notify the public of the upcoming impacts. Motorists should plan ahead, allow extra travel time and use caution when traveling through the work zone. Project Background A project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on a portion of I-71 in Gallatin and Carroll counties began on March 3, 2025. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes in each direction with a shared median wall. I-71 is being widened in the following areas: Gallatin County: beginning at the Carroll/Gallatin County line (mile point 53.41) extending northeasterly to west of Sparta Pike (KY 35) (mile point 57.36), a distance of 3.95 miles. Carroll County: beginning at mile point 52.77 extending northeasterly to the Carroll/Gallatin County line (mile point 53.41), a distance of 0.64 miles. Traffic on I-71 northbound has been shifted from the original northbound lanes into the median while crews reconstruct the original northbound lanes. Two lanes of northbound traffic are being maintained and separated by the permanent barrier wall. During this phase, crews are removing the existing pavement and completing shoulder work on I-71 northbound. This widening project includes a bridge replacement over KY 47. The existing bridges are being replaced with a new, single span bridge matching the median widening throughout the project area. The speed limit has been reduced throughout the project area to 55 miles-per-hour to keep crews safe as they work to improve the corridor. Eaton Asphalt Paving Co., Inc. is contracted to perform the nearly $42 million project on behalf of KYTC. Weather permitting, the overall project has an expected completion date of Nov. 1, 2026. You can find more information on the project here. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook and X (formerly Twitter). For statewide traffic and travel updates, visit GoKY.

description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight routine bridge maintenance work on the Interstate 275 Carroll Cropper Bridge in Boone County over the Ohio River between Kentucky and Indiana. Motorists should expect lane closures and maintenance crews in the work zone. Please use caution while traveling through the area to keep our crews safe. Weather permitting, this work is expected to be completed by 7 a.m. Friday, July 10. We will advise if additional days are needed to complete the work due to potential inclement weather.

title: I-71 North-South between MM 0.1 and 2.0 Between I-64/I-71 Interchange and Zorn Ave. in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : The I-71 widening and improvement project is a $50 million infrastructure investment to enhance safety and improve mobility along one of Louisville's most critical travel corridors. The two-year project, focused on increasing traffic capacity and safety, will enhance regional connectivity, provide reliable travel for years to come, and support economic growth. The project spans approximately two miles of interstate from the I-65/I-71 interchange near Frankfort Avenue to the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange. Additional improvements include the construction of a multi-use path along Zorn Avenue between the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange and Mellwood Avenue, as well as a new median treatment at the intersection of Zorn Avenue and Mellwood Avenue to enhance safety and better define traffic movements. The project also includes the demolition and reconstruction of the I-71 bridge over Beargrass Creek, along with a latex overlay on the I-71 bridge over I-64 at mile point 0.3 to extend the structure’s service life. For additional information, please visist https://transportation.ky.gov/DistrictFive/Pages/I-71-Widening---Louisville-.aspx.

description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of the updated schedule for overnight ramp closures on Interstate 64 East in Franklin County. The ramp closures listed below are necessary for contract crews to perform asphalt paving operations. Beginning Wednesday, July 15, at 8 p.m., through Thursday, July 16, at 12 a.m. Closure of the I-64 East off-ramp to U.S. 127 North at Exit 53B Beginning Wednesday, July 15, at 12 a.m., through Thursday, July 16, at 6 a.m. Closure of the I-64 East off-ramp to U.S. 60 (Versailles Road) at Exit 58 Beginning Thursday, July 16, at 8 p.m., through Friday, July 17, at 6 a.m. Closure of the I-64 East on-ramp from U.S. 127 Motorists are advised to follow all traffic control restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. title: I-71 North between MM 1.5 and 2.5 Area of Zorn Avenue in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight traffic impacts on Interstate 71 North beginning Monday, July 20, as part of the $50 million I-71 widening and improvement project in Louisville [links-1.govdelivery.com]. To safely facilitate bridge construction, I-71 North will be reduced to one lane each night from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m., with brief rolling closures occurring between midnight and 4 a.m., on the following dates: Beginning at 8 p.m. on Monday, July 20, through 5 a.m. on Tuesday, July 21 Beginning at 8 p.m. on Tuesday, July 21, through 5 a.m. on Wednesday, July 22 Beginning at 8 p.m. on Wednesday, July 22, through 5 a.m. on Thursday, July 23 During the overnight rolling closures (between midnight and 4 a.m.), motorists traveling on I-71 North will be diverted to exit at Exit 2 (Zorn Avenue) and immediately re-enter the interstate using the I-71 North on-ramp. This short, signed detour will be used while traffic is temporarily stopped to allow crews to safely set bridge beams between midnight and 4 a.m. To help minimize delays, traffic signals at the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange will be placed in flashing mode, and flaggers will be stationed at all approaches to efficiently direct motorists through the interchange. Additionally, brief closures of Zorn Avenue are possible to allow crews to safely move and set bridge beams. Motorists should reduce speed, follow posted signage and flagger directions, and allow extra travel time during the scheduled overnight work.

title: I-275 East between MM 82.0 and 79.5 Between Turkeyfoot Road and Madison Pike in Kenton County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of evening and overnight lane closures on Interstate 275 in Kenton County beginning Tuesday, July 21. Crews will be performing concrete repairs on several bridge decks. Crews will be blocking the left two lanes on I-275 eastbound from Turkeyfoot Road (KY 1303) (82 mile marker) to east of the bridge over Madison Pike (KY 17) (79.53 mile point), a distance of 2.47 miles. Lane closures will begin at 7 p.m. All lanes will reopen by 6 a.m. daily. All ramps are expected to remain open during this project. Motorists should anticipate some delays and are encouraged to find alternate routes. Weather permitting, this maintenance work is expected to be completed Friday, July 24 at 6 a.m. KYTC will advise if additional nights of work are needed. This project is part of a series of projects focused on concrete repairs to improve conditions on our area's interstate bridges. KYTC will advise when work shifts to other local bridge overpasses. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow [links-1.govdelivery.com] or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress [links-1.govdelivery.com] website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly Twitter). For statewide traffic and travel updates, visit GoKY [links-1.govdelivery.com].

description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 West beginning Sunday, July 26, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. through 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, July 26, through Friday, Aug. 7, on I-64 West between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to perform asphalt paving operations. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. title: I-64 West between MM 43.6 and 35.1 Between Waddy Road and Mt. Eden Road in Shelby County
description: Construction / Road Work : As part of the $118 million widening and improvement project in Shelby County [links-1.govdelivery.com], the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of upcoming overnight closures of Interstate 64 beginning Monday, July 27. I-64 West will be closed from 7 p.m. Monday, July 27, through 4 a.m. Tuesday, July 28, from mile point 43.6 to mile point 35.1. Motorists should follow the posted detour of taking the off-ramp to KY 395 (Waddy Road) at Exit 43, to U.S. 60 (Frankfort Road) to KY 53 (Mt. Eden Road) to reconnect with I-64 West. I-64 East will be closed from 7 p.m. Thursday, July 30, through 4 a.m. Friday, July 31, from mile point 35.1 to mile point 43.6. Motorists should follow the posted detour of taking the off-ramp to KY 53 (Mt. Eden Road) at Exit 35, to U.S. 60 (Frankfort Road) to KY 395 (Waddy Road) to reconnect with I-64 East. The overnight interstate closures are necessary for contract crews to set beams for the KY 1790 (Hooper Station Road) bridge over I-64 as part of the bridge replacement work. As construction progresses, additional overnight closures are expected on this stretch of I-64. KY 1790 (Hooper Station Road) over I-64, between mile points 3.0 and 3.25, remains closed and is expected to reopen in October of 2026 following completion of the bridge. Motorists should continue to follow the posted detour of taking KY 53 (Mt. Eden Road) to U.S. 60 (Frankfort Road) to KY 714 (Hemp Ridge Road) to reconnect with KY 1790 (Hooper Station Road). All work being performed is part of the $118 million I-64 widening and improvement project in Shelby County, which began in February 2025. The project will increase capacity, upgrade a key interchange, and modernize bridges, ensuring a more efficient and reliable transportation network for motorists. The three-year project includes widening and pavement upgrades of an 11-mile section of I-64, reconstruction of the KY 53 interchange, rebuilding of three bridges over I-64, and widening of four existing I-64 bridges. These improvements will enhance daily travel while also supporting future growth in the region. The interstate project is expected to be completed by the Fall of 2027. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. title: I-275 East-West between MM 12.9 and 13.8 Area of Carroll Lee Cropper Bridge in Boone County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Non-Redundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspection is a close-up, hands-on examination of the bridge’s critical members. The most recent routine inspection on the Carroll Cropper Memorial Bridge took place July 2025. The NSTM inspection will require single lane closures on the four-lane bridge from Monday, July 13, through Friday, July 24. Motorists should expect intermittent single lane closures throughout the inspection period outside of the lane closure restriction times listed below. The lane closure restriction times have been put in place to mitigate traffic delays during peak travel times. Lane closure restrictions: I-275 eastbound: No closures Monday through Thursday from 3 p.m. to 6 p.m. Additionally, Friday from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. I-275 westbound: No closures Monday through Friday from 6 a.m. to 8 a.m. Additionally, Friday from 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. The inspection is being performed by AECOM. Weather permitting, the overall project has an expected completion date of Friday, July 24. I-275 Carroll Cropper Bridge –​ 13.56 mile point – A routine bridge inspection is underway. This work will require daily single lane closures: I-275 Eastbound: 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. I-275 Westbound: 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Weather permitting, this inspection is expected to be completed by Friday, July 24. I-275 – 12.985 mile point – Overnight rolling roadblocks on a portion of I-275 to install new overhead utility wires spanning I-275 west of Exit 11 (to Petersburg) is complete. U.S. 42 – 0.0 – 5.67 mile points –​ A resurfacing project on U.S. 42 between the Boone/Gallatin County line and Richwood Road is in progress. Milling and paving operations began Tuesday, July 14. ​​Motorists should expect single lane closures throughout the project area. When Boone County Schools are in session, this work will take place between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m. There are no time restrictions for work when school is out for spring and summer break. Weather permitting, this work is expected to be completed late Summer 2026.

title: I-64 West between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 West beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. through 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, through Friday, Aug. 14, on I-64 West between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to perform asphalt paving operations. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Information specific to District 5 counties is also available on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com].

title: I-71 North between MM 53.0 and 57.0 Between KY-47 and Sparta PK in Carroll County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight traffic impacts on Interstate 71 northbound beginning Monday, Aug. 3, as part of the ongoing I-71 widening project on an approximately 4.59 mile portion of I-71 in Gallatin and Carroll Counties. Tentative Schedule of Work (Weather Permitting): Beginning at 8 p.m. Monday, Aug. 3, crews will close a single northbound lane of traffic between mile markers 53 and 57. The right lane will be closed while crews perform drainage work in the median. The following ramp closures will also be in place: I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 55 (KY 1039) I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) Beginning as early as Tuesday, Aug. 4, the on-ramp from Exit 55 (KY 1039) to I-71 northbound will also be closed during working hours. A signed detour will be in place occur this closure begins. Lane and ramp closures will be removed by 5 a.m. each morning. Weather permitting, the work is expected to be completed by 5 a.m. Thursday, Aug. 6. Motorists should plan ahead, allow extra travel time and use caution when traveling through the work zone. Project Background A project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on a portion of I-71 in Gallatin and Carroll counties began on March 3, 2025. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes in each direction with a shared median wall. I-71 is being widened in the following areas: Gallatin County: beginning at the Carroll/Gallatin County line (mile point 53.41) extending northeasterly to west of Sparta Pike (KY 35) (mile point 57.36), a distance of 3.95 miles. Carroll County: beginning at mile point 52.77 extending northeasterly to the Carroll/Gallatin County line (mile point 53.41), a distance of 0.64 miles. Traffic on I-71 northbound has been shifted from the original northbound lanes into the median while crews reconstruct the original northbound lanes. Two lanes of northbound traffic are being maintained and separated by the permanent barrier wall. During this phase, crews are removing the existing pavement and completing shoulder work on I-71 northbound. This widening project includes a bridge replacement over KY 47. The existing bridges are being replaced with a new, single span bridge matching the median widening throughout the project area. The speed limit has been reduced throughout the project area to 55 miles-per-hour to keep crews safe as they work to improve the corridor. Eaton Asphalt Paving Co., Inc. is contracted to perform the nearly $42 million project on behalf of KYTC. Weather permitting, the overall project has an expected completion date of Nov. 1, 2026. You can find more information on the project here [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow [links-1.govdelivery.com] or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress [links-1.govdelivery.com] website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly Twitter). For statewide traffic and travel updates, visit GoKY [links-1.govdelivery.com].

title: I-71/75 South Ramp from Crescent Ave / Fourth Street (KY 8) in Kenton County
description: Construction / Road Work : COVINGTON, Ky. (Aug. 6, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming overnight lane and ramp closure on Interstates 71/75 in Kenton County on Thursday, Aug. 6 and Sunday, Aug. 9. The closures are necessary to provide crews a safe area to perform pavement work and restriping operations as part of the ongoing Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project. On Thursday, Aug. 6, beginning at 8 p.m., the I-71/75 southbound on-ramp from Crescent Avenue/Fourth Street (KY 8) will close. Additionally, the right lane on I-71/75 southbound from after the W. Fifth Street exit (KY 8) (191.3 mile point) to south of 12th Street (190 mile marker), a distance of 1.3 miles. The ramp and lane is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Friday, Aug. 7. Access to the Pike Street (U.S. 25) exit will be maintained from I-71/75 southbound. Motorists accessing the Pike Street off-ramp will not have access to re-enter I-71/75. The same closures listed above will also take place on Sunday, Aug. 9 from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. for striping operations. The lane and ramp is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 10. Motorists should plan ahead and find alternate routes to avoid potential delays. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

title: I-65 South between MM 137.0 and 136.5 On Kennedy Bridge in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : As work on the final phase of the expansion joint replacement project on the John F. Kennedy Memorial Bridge nears completion, contract crews will implement lane and ramp closures beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, to safely restore the bridge to its permanent traffic configuration. The project will preserve and extend the service life of this critical Ohio River crossing. Beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, at 8 p.m., through 6 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.: The Court Avenue and 6th Street on-ramps to I-65 South in Jeffersonville, Indiana, will be closed. The right two lanes of the Kennedy Bridge and the I-65 South to I-64 West ramp will be closed. Beginning Friday, Aug. 7, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 10, at 6 a.m. (If inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances arise, contract crews will perform the below traffic control measures beginning Friday, Aug. 14, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.): The right three lanes of the Kennedy Bridge will be closed. Motorists should heed signage, use caution, and plan for additional travel time. Kennedy Bridge Expansion Joint Project Work on replacing bridge expansion joints began in February 2025 as a more permanent solution for damaged joints and to replace all joints, promoting safer and smoother traffic flow. Expansion joints are critical components of a bridge deck that allow the structure to safely expand and contract with temperature changes. This flexibility helps prevent cracking and preserves the bridge’s long-term structural integrity. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Information specific to District 5 counties is also available on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com].

title: I-64 East between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight lane and ramp closures scheduled Aug. 9-14 on I-64 in Franklin County for road work. Beginning Sunday, Aug. 9, at 7 p.m., until Friday, Aug. 14, at 6 a.m., alternating nightly lane closures will occur on I-64 East between mile markers 53 and 58 for roadway shoulder work. During the lane closure, and in addition to reducing speed, maintaining safe following distances, and proceeding with caution through the work zone, drivers should expect delays and are encouraged to allow extra time to reach their destination. Motorists seeking an alternative route during the ramp closure are recommended to use Exit 58, US 60 Versailles Road to US 127. The work is part of a 5-mile improvement project, taking place between the Frankfort mile markers 53 and 58, which includes the milling and removal of the existing asphalt surface, followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Additional updates on traffic impacts will be provided in District 5’s weekly Roadshow Report: https://transportation.ky.gov/DistrictFive/Pages/KYTC-District-5-Roadshow.aspx [links-1.govdelivery.com]. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. Visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com] for the latest in traffic and travel information in the Commonwealth of Kentucky. You can also get traffic information for the District 5 counties on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly known as Twitter). ###

title: I-71 North-South between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between Sparta Pike and KY-1039 in Gallatin County
description: Construction / Road Work : I-71 – 52.77 – 57.36 mile points – A widening project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on I-71 in Carroll and Gallatin counties is in progress. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes. Ramp closures on I-71 northbound in Gallatin County are scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9. Crews will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, these ramps will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. A signed detour will be in place utilizing Boone Road (KY 465). The following ramps will be closed: -Exit 55 (KY 1039) on-ramp to I-71 southbound -I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) Weather permitting, these ramp closures are expected to be in place through Sunday, Aug. 23. Additional updates will be provided if more time is needed to complete the work. Additionally, a single lane closure on I-71 northbound between Exit 55 and Exit 57 will begin at 7 p.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9, to allow crews to adjust the barrier wall. The I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 55 (KY 1039) will also be closed during this time. Both closures are expected to be removed by 8 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 10.

title: I-71/75 South Ramps from 4th Street and Crescent Avenue in Kenton County
description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE (Aug. 11, 2026) -- An additional night of work is needed to complete this portion of the project. The same traffic impacts listed below will take place on Tuesday, Aug. 11 beginning at 8 p.m. The lane and ramp is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Wednesday, Aug. 12. This work is weather permitting. If the work is postponed due to inclement weather, KYTC will provide an update once the work is rescheduled. COVINGTON, Ky. (Aug. 6, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming overnight lane and ramp closure on Interstates 71/75 in Kenton County on Thursday, Aug. 6 and Sunday, Aug. 9. The closures are necessary to provide crews a safe area to perform pavement work and restriping operations as part of the ongoing Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project. On Thursday, Aug. 6, beginning at 8 p.m., the I-71/75 southbound on-ramp from Crescent Avenue/Fourth Street (KY 8) will close. Additionally, the right lane on I-71/75 southbound from after the W. Fifth Street exit (KY 8) (191.3 mile point) to south of 12th Street (190 mile marker), a distance of 1.3 miles. The ramp and lane is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Friday, Aug. 7. Access to the Pike Street (U.S. 25) exit will be maintained from I-71/75 southbound. Motorists accessing the Pike Street off-ramp will not have access to re-enter I-71/75. The same closures listed above will also take place on Sunday, Aug. 9 from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. for striping operations. The lane and ramp is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 10. Motorists should plan ahead and find alternate routes to avoid potential delays. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. About the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project The Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project is one of the nation’s most significant transportation transformations, spanning eight miles of I-71/75 in Kentucky and I-75 in Ohio. In addition to constructing a new companion bridge, the project will upgrade the existing Brent Spence Bridge to carry local traffic; improve safety and reduce congestion by separating local and through travel; redesign ramp configurations throughout the corridor; and add new pedestrian and bicycle connections linking neighborhoods to jobs and transit. This once-in-a-generation investment will strengthen national freight movement, support local businesses and workforce growth, and enhance quality of life for the millions who rely on this critical corridor. For more information, visit brentspencebridgecorridor.com [links-1.govdelivery.com].

description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE (Aug. 12, 2026) -- Due to inclement weather on Tuesday, Aug. 11, the scheduled work was postponed to Wednesday, Aug. 12. Weather permitting, the same traffic impacts listed below will take place on Wednesday, Aug. 12 beginning at 8 p.m. The lane and ramp is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Thursday, Aug. 13. If the work is postponed once again due to inclement weather, KYTC will provide an update once the work is rescheduled. COVINGTON, Ky. (Aug. 6, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming overnight lane and ramp closure on Interstates 71/75 in Kenton County on Thursday, Aug. 6 and Sunday, Aug. 9. The closures are necessary to provide crews a safe area to perform pavement work and restriping operations as part of the ongoing Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project. On Thursday, Aug. 6, beginning at 8 p.m., the I-71/75 southbound on-ramp from Crescent Avenue/Fourth Street (KY 8) will close. Additionally, the right lane on I-71/75 southbound from after the W. Fifth Street exit (KY 8) (191.3 mile point) to south of 12th Street (190 mile marker), a distance of 1.3 miles. The ramp and lane is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Friday, Aug. 7. Access to the Pike Street (U.S. 25) exit will be maintained from I-71/75 southbound. Motorists accessing the Pike Street off-ramp will not have access to re-enter I-71/75. The same closures listed above will also take place on Sunday, Aug. 9 from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. for striping operations. The lane and ramp is expected to reopen by 5 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 10. Motorists should plan ahead and find alternate routes to avoid potential delays. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

title: I-64 East-West between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 East and West beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. through 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, through Friday, Aug. 21, on I-64 East and West between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to apply a concrete overlay to the I-64 bridges over U.S. 60 (Versailles Road), install shoulder rumble strips, perform pavement striping and place pavement markers. In addition to the overnight alternating lane closures on I-64 East and West, overnight alternating lane closures will be in place on U.S. 60 (Versailles Road) beneath the I-64 bridges at mile point 57.9 from 9 p.m. to 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, through Friday, Aug. 21. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zones, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. title: I-65 South between MM 137.0 and 136.5 On Kennedy Bridge in Jefferson County
description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE 8/15/2026 Beginning Saturday, Aug. 15, at 12 p.m., through Sunday, Aug. 16, at 6 p.m. The right three lanes of the Kennedy Bridge will be closed. The I-65 South to I-64 West ramp remains closed and will reopen on Sunday, Aug. 16, at 6 p.m. As work on the final phase of the expansion joint replacement project on the John F. Kennedy Memorial Bridge nears completion, contract crews will implement lane and ramp closures beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, to safely restore the bridge to its permanent traffic configuration. The project will preserve and extend the service life of this critical Ohio River crossing. Beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, at 8 p.m., through 6 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.: The Court Avenue and 6th Street on-ramps to I-65 South in Jeffersonville, Indiana, will be closed. The right two lanes of the Kennedy Bridge and the I-65 South to I-64 West ramp will be closed. Beginning Friday, Aug. 7, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 10, at 6 a.m. (If inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances arise, contract crews will perform the below traffic control measures beginning Friday, Aug. 14, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.): The right three lanes of the Kennedy Bridge will be closed. Motorists should heed signage, use caution, and plan for additional travel time. Kennedy Bridge Expansion Joint Project Work on replacing bridge expansion joints began in February 2025 as a more permanent solution for damaged joints and to replace all joints, promoting safer and smoother traffic flow. Expansion joints are critical components of a bridge deck that allow the structure to safely expand and contract with temperature changes. This flexibility helps prevent cracking and preserves the bridge’s long-term structural integrity. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Information specific to District 5 counties is also available on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com].

description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming bridge maintenance project on Interstate 275 in Kenton and Campbell counties beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18. These repairs involve saw-cutting damaged concrete in localized areas and re-pouring those sections to provide a long-lasting repair. The following traffic impacts are scheduled, weather permitting: Campbell County: Tuesday, Aug 18: I-275 eastbound over I-471 northbound and southbound (mile point 75.3 to 74.6) A single lane closure will begin at 6 p.m., followed by a double lane closure at 9 p.m. All lane closures will be removed by 6 a.m. The schedule may shift depending on weather conditions and the progress of repairs. Updates will be provided if the schedule changes. Motorists should anticipate some delays and are encouraged to find alternate routes. Weather permitting, this portion of the work is expected to be completed by 5 a.m. Sunday, Aug. 23. KYTC will advise if additional nights of work are needed. This project is part of a series of work focused on concrete repairs to improve conditions on interstate bridges in Boone, Campbell and Kenton counties. title: I-71/75 North between MM 191.2 and 191.6 Between 12th Street/MLK Blvd and 3rd Street in Kenton County
description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of a single overnight lane closure on a portion of Interstate 71/75 northbound in Kenton County and I-71 in Ohio beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18. Crews will be performing preparation work ahead of demolishing the Second Street exit ramp. An overnight northbound single right lane closure will be in place from the beginning of the Brent Spence Bridge approach on the Kentucky side (191.2 mile point) to just past the Second Street exit (0.5 mile point in Ohio). One lane of traffic will be maintained in Ohio on I-71 northbound. Eight nights of work are expected for this portion of the project. Weather permitting, the lane closure times are listed below with the lane reopening the following morning: Tuesday, Aug. 18: 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. Wednesday, Aug. 19: 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. Thursday, Aug. 20: 11 p.m. to 5:30 a.m. Friday, Aug. 21: 11:30 p.m. to 7 a.m. Saturday, Aug. 22: 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday, Aug. 23: 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. Monday, Aug. 24: 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. Tuesday, Aug. 25: 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. About the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project The Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project is one of the nation’s most significant transportation transformations, spanning eight miles of I-71/75 in Kentucky and I-75 in Ohio. Construction will begin with the new companion bridge to the west of the Brent Spence Bridge and one mile of approach work in each state. In addition to the new bridge, the project will restripe the existing Brent Spence Bridge to carry local traffic; improve safety and reduce congestion by separating local and through travel; redesign ramp configurations throughout the corridor; and add new pedestrian and bicycle connections linking neighborhoods to jobs and transit. This once-in-a-generation investment will strengthen national freight movement, support local businesses and workforce growth, and enhance quality of life for the millions who rely on this critical corridor. For more information, visit brentspencebridgecorridor.com [links-1.govdelivery.com].

description: Construction / Road Work : A widening project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on I-71 in Carroll and Gallatin counties is in progress. Ramp closures on I-71 northbound in Gallatin County are scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9. Crews will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, these ramps will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. A signed detour will be in place utilizing Boone Road (KY 465). The following ramps will be closed: -Exit 55 (KY 1039) on-ramp to I-71 southbound -I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) Weather permitting, these ramp closures are expected to be in place through Sunday, Aug. 23. Additional updates will be provided if more time is needed to complete the work. Weather permitting, the overall project is expected to be completed Nov. 1, 2026. In addition to the new bridge, the project will restripe the existing Brent Spence Bridge to carry local traffic; improve safety and reduce congestion by separating local and through travel; redesign ramp configurations throughout the corridor; and add new pedestrian and bicycle connections linking neighborhoods to jobs and transit. This once-in-a-generation investment will strengthen national freight movement, support local businesses and workforce growth, and enhance quality of life for the millions who rely on this critical corridor. description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming bridge maintenance project on Interstate 275 in Kenton and Campbell counties beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18. These repairs involve saw-cutting damaged concrete in localized areas and re-pouring those sections to provide a long-lasting repair. The following traffic impacts are scheduled, weather permitting: Campbell County: Tuesday, Aug 18: I-275 eastbound over I-471 northbound and southbound (mile point 75.3 to 74.6) A single lane closure will begin at 6 p.m., followed by a double lane closure at 9 p.m. All lane closures will be removed by 6 a.m. Kenton County: Wednesday, Aug. 19 through Saturday, Aug. 22: I-275 over Madison Pike (KY 17) (mile point 79.8 to 80.3) Crews will begin work on the eastbound portion of the bridge before shifting to the westbound portion once repairs are complete. Updates will be provided if the schedule changes. Motorists should anticipate some delays and are encouraged to find alternate routes. Weather permitting, this portion of the work is expected to be completed by 5 a.m. Sunday, Aug. 23. KYTC will advise if additional nights of work are needed. This project is part of a series of work focused on concrete repairs to improve conditions on interstate bridges in Boone, Campbell and Kenton counties.
